channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Mexico: Mareykanka oo diyaarad basaas ah oo aan duuliye lahayn u duuliyay qabashada ganacsade daroogo oo caan ah
item.description: Saraakiisha amniga Mexico ayaa Isniintii sheegay in Mareykanku uu dhulka Mexico dul marsiiyay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo basaasnimo, si ay uga caawiso raadinta iyo qabashada Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, oo loo yaqaan 'El Chapo Isidro'.

item.title: SEC oo 3 December shir gaar ah u qabanaysa go'aanka in LSU laga saaro, khilaafka RJ Luis dartiis
item.description: Shirarka SEC ee isboortiga jaamacadaha Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii dukumiinti maxkamadeed ku sheegay inay 3 December shir gaar ah ku eegi doonaan in xubinnimada jaamacadda LSU la joojiyo, iyadoo khilaafka ciyaaryahanka kubbadda koleyga RJ Luis uu gaaray heer cusub.

item.title: Maxkamadda racfaanka oo dib u furtay dadaalka Trump ee ah in kiiska lacagta aamusnaanta loo wareejiyo maxkamad federaal
item.description: Saddex garsoore oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Racfaanka ee 2nd Circuit ayaa Isniintii dib u soo nooleeyay codsiga Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee ah in kiiskiisa dambiyeed ee lacagta aamusnaanta ee New York loo wareejiyo maxkamad federaal.

item.title: Bukele oo shaaciyay magacyada saddex askari oo El Salvador ah oo ku dhintay hawlgal ka dhan ah burcadda Haiti
item.description: Madaxweynaha El Salvador Nayib Bukele ayaa magacaabay saddex askari oo dalkiisa ah oo ku dhintay hawlgal ka dhan ah kooxaha hubaysan ee Haiti, wuxuuna sheegay in qoys kasta la siin doono 200,000 oo doollar.

item.title: Mareykanka oo shirkadda Megaspeed iyo lix kale ku daray liiska madow ee dhoofinta tiknoolajiyadda
item.description: Xafiiska Amniga iyo Warshadaha ee Mareykanka (BIS) ayaa Isniintii shirkadda Megaspeed International ee fadhigeedu yahay Singapore iyo lix shirkadood oo kale ku daray liiska xakamaynta dhoofinta, saacado kadib markii Jensen Huang uu dib ugu soo laabtay xilka maamulaha guud ee Nvidia.

item.title: Zelensky oo ku baaqay wadahadal nabadeed oo afar dhinac ah oo Ruushka, Yurub iyo Mareykanka ay ka qaybgalaan
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa Isniintii ku baaqay in sida ugu dhaqsaha badan la qabto wareeg cusub oo wadahadal ah oo ay ka qaybgalaan Ukraine, Ruushka, Mareykanka iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Yurub, isagoo sheegay in Kyiv ay diyaar u tahay kulan dhici kara Talaadada.

item.title: Midowga Yurub oo soo jeediyay cunaqabateyn cusub oo Ruushka ka mamnuucaysa tartamada ciyaaraha
item.description: Guddiga Midowga Yurub ayaa Isniintii soo bandhigay xirmadii 22aad ee cunaqabateynta Ruushka, oo bartilmaameedsanaysa bangiyo, madalaha lacagaha crypto-ga iyo ka qaybgalka Ruushka ee tartamada ciyaaraha ee dalalka Midowga.

item.title: Luis de la Fuente oo uga digay Faransiiska: 'Waxay wajihi doonaan kooxda ugu fiican adduunka'
item.description: Tababaraha xulka Spain Luis de la Fuente ayaa Isniintii muujiyay kalsooni weyn kahor labada kulan ee wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka Nations League ee ay Spain la ciyaari doonto Faransiiska 25 iyo 28 March.

item.title: Dab ka kacay hoteel ku yaal xeebta Nungwi ee Zanzibar oo gaaray hoteello iyo dukaanno kale
item.description: Dab xooggan oo ka kacay hoteelka Makofi ee xeebta Nungwi, waqooyiga Zanzibar, ayaa ku fiday hoteello, makhaayado iyo dukaanno ku dhow, halka saraakiishu sheegeen in dhammaan 183 dalxiisayaal ah ay ka badbaadeen.

item.title: Brentford oo 4-0 ku jebisay Everton, Tarkowski oo helay kaarkiisii ugu horreeyay ee cas
item.description: Brentford ayaa Isniintii 4-0 kaga adkaatay Everton oo 10 ciyaartoy ku dhammeysay kulankii ku xirmay toddobaadka 11aad ee Premier League, iyadoo Keane Lewis-Potter uu dhaliyay 2 gool.

item.title: Arizona Cardinals oo shaqada ka eriyay isku-duwaha difaaca Nick Rallis
item.description: Kooxda NFL ee Arizona Cardinals ayaa xilka ka qaaday isku-duwaha difaaca Nick Rallis, sida ay sheegeen warbixino badan, iyadoo Teryl Austin uu si ku meel gaar ah u qaban doono jagada.

item.title: Guingamp oo xiriir la sameysay Cyril Hanouna si uu u caawiyo kooxda xilli ay dhibaato dhaqaale ku jirto
item.description: Kooxda Ligue 2 ee En Avant Guingamp ayaa la sheegay inay wada-hadal la furtay soo-saare iyo bandhig-gudbiye telefishan caan ah oo Faransiis ah, Cyril Hanouna, si uu u noqdo saamile oo uu kooxda uga caawiyo dhibaatada dhaqaale.

item.title: San Francisco 49ers oo heshiiska u kordhisay maareeyaha guud John Lynch
item.description: Kooxda NFL-ka ee San Francisco 49ers ayaa kordhisay heshiiska John Lynch, madaxa hawlaha kubadda iyo maareeyaha guud ee kooxda, oo sannadkan tobnaad la joogo kooxda.

item.title: San Francisco 49ers oo sii daayay Brandon Aiyuk kadib muddo dheer oo uu dhaawac ku maqnaa
item.description: Kooxda NFL-ka ee San Francisco 49ers ayaa Isniintii sii daysay ciyaaryahanka Brandon Aiyuk, oo aan ciyaar NFL ah ciyaarin tan iyo markii uu dhaawac culus jilibka kaga dhacay xilli ciyaareedkii 2024.

item.title: Ruushka oo ku eedeeyay Estonia ficillo cadownimo, kana digay in ay qarka u saaran tahay dagaal furan
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Isniintii ku eedeysay Estonia ficillo cadownimo ah, iyadoo sheegtay in dalkaas xubinta ka ah NATO uu qarka u saaran yahay inuu kiciyo dagaal furan, kadib markii Tallinn ay ku dhawaaqday inay xireyso xuduudda.

item.title: Guterres oo dalalka ugu baaqay inay sannad gudihii ku heshiiyaan nidaam caalami ah oo lagu maamulo AI
item.description: Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay António Guterres ayaa Isniintii shir ka socday Barbados ku sheegay in dalalku ay sannad gudihii ku heshiiyaan qaab caalami ah oo lagu maareeyo khataraha sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI), oo leh kormeer madax-bannaan.

item.title: Stellantis oo kooxaheeda kala baxaysa tartamada baabuurta, Peugeot iyo Le Mans, Citroën iyo Opel-na Formula E
item.description: Shirkadda weyn ee baabuurta Stellantis ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday inay kooxaheeda ka saaraysa tartamada baabuurta, si ay diiradda u saarto qorshe ay ku soo celinayso faa'iidadeeda, iyadoo ka bixi doonta tartamada adduunka ee FIA dhammaadka 2027.

item.title: Jude Bellingham iyo Real Madrid oo la sheegay inay ku jiraan wadahadallo horumarsan oo heshiis cusub ah
item.description: Warbixinno ka soo baxay Ingiriiska iyo Spain ayaa sheegaya in Real Madrid iyo Jude Bellingham ay gaareen heer horumarsan wadahadallada heshiis cusub oo muddo dheer ah, inkastoo aan weli heshiis la gaarin.

item.title: FIFA oo ansixisay: Koobka Adduunka Haweenka 2031 Mareykanka iyo saddex dal, 2035-na Boqortooyada Ingiriiska
item.description: Shir-weyne gaar ah oo FIFA ayaa Isniintii ansixiyay in Koobka Adduunka Haweenka ee 2031 ay wada martigeliyaan Mareykanka, Mexico, Costa Rica iyo Jamaica, kan 2035-na uu ka dhaco Boqortooyada Ingiriiska.

item.title: Xasan Sheekh iyo Museveni oo war-murtiyeed wadajir ah ku baaqay wadahadal siyaasadeed iyo xoojinta AUSSOM
item.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa Isniintii Uganda kaga wada hadlay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, waxayna war-murtiyeed wadajir ah ku adkeeyeen in dowladda federaalku wadahadal la yeelato dowlad-goboleedyada iyo dhinacyada kale.

item.title: Cyprien Sarrazin oo laba sano kadib shil culus dib ugu soo laabanaya Koobka Adduunka ee Ski-ga
item.description: Xiriirka Ski-ga Faransiiska ayaa Isniintii Cyprien Sarrazin ku daray kooxda tartanka super-G ee Sabtida ka dhacaya Copper Mountain ee Mareykanka, laba sano kadib shil culus oo uu ku dhaawacmay.

item.title: Finland oo u yeeratay safiirka Ruushka kadib helikobtar Ruush ah oo looga shakiyay inuu ku xadgudbay hawadeeda
item.description: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Finland ayaa Isniintii u yeeratay safiirka Ruushka, maalmo kadib markii helikobtar Ruush ah looga shakiyay inuu galay hawada Finland, waxayna cambaareysay weerarrada Moscow ee ka dhanka ah bartilmaameedyada rayidka ee Ukraine.

item.title: Dukumiintiyo la daadiyay: Infantino oo doonayay in Koobka Adduunka 96 sano loo iibiyo maalgashadeyaal
item.description: Dukumiintiyo la daadiyay ayaa muujinaya in madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino uu dejiyay qorshe ku saabsan in hawlaha ganacsiga iyo tartamada FIFA, oo uu ku jiro Koobka Adduunka, loo furo maalgashi gaar ah muddo gaaraysa 96 sano.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Uganda oo la filayo inuu booqasho ku yimaado Soomaaliya
item.description: Warar hoose oo laga helayo ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, uu qorsheynayo booqasho uu ku imaan karo Muqdisho, inkasta oo aanay labada dowladood weli si rasmi ah u shaacin safarkan.

item.title: Tomáš Rosický oo ka tagay xilka agaasimaha ciyaaraha ee Sparta Prague kadib siddeed sano
item.description: Kooxda Sparta Prague ee Czech ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday in ay heshiis ku kala tageen agaasimaheeda ciyaaraha Tomáš Rosický, oo xilkaas hayay tan iyo December 2018, waxaana xilka si ku-meel-gaar ah loogu wareejiyay Tomáš Sivok.

item.title: David Raya oo seegi doona kulanka Dortmund, Arteta-na sheegay in dhaawaca garabku aanu culus ahayn
item.description: Tababaraha Arsenal Mikel Arteta ayaa Isniintii sheegay in goolhaye David Raya uusan u diyaar ahayn kulanka Talaadada ee Champions League ee Borussia Dortmund, balse dhaawaca garabkiisa bidix uu u muuqdo mid aan culus ahayn.

item.title: Goolhayaha Jarmalka Ann-Katrin Berger oo ku biiraysa Union Berlin bisha January
item.description: Union Berlin ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday inay la soo wareegtay goolhayaha xulka Jarmalka Ann-Katrin Berger, oo kooxda ku biiri doonta January 2027 marka uu dhammaado heshiiskeeda Gotham FC ee Mareykanka.

item.title: Emre Mor oo 29 jir ah oo hakiyay xirfaddiisa kubbadda cagta, kadib markii NEC Nijmegen ay heshiiskiisa joojisay
item.description: Kooxda Holland ee NEC Nijmegen ayaa Isniintii, 23 November, ku dhawaaqday inay si wadajir ah ula joojisay heshiiska garabka Turkiga Emre Mor, isla markiiba, iyadoo warbixinnada ay sheegayaan in ciyaaryahanku hakinayo xirfaddiisa ciyaareed.

item.title: Mourinho oo difaacay Vinícius kahor kulanka Real Madrid iyo PSV ee Champions League
item.description: Tababaraha Real Madrid José Mourinho ayaa kahor kulanka Talaadada ee PSV Eindhoven difaacay Vinícius Júnior, isagoo sheegay in xiddigga reer Brazil uusan u baahnayn inuu kulan kasta noqdo ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican haddii uu wax walba bixiyo.

item.title: Jannik Sinner oo la sheegay in qalliin jilibka laga sameynayo, laguna wado inuu seego Australian Open
item.description: Ciyaartoyga tennis-ka Talyaaniga Jannik Sinner, oo ah kaalinta 2-aad ee adduunka, ayaa la sheegay in Talaadada qalliin lagaga sameynayo jilibka midig magaalada Turku ee Finland, taas oo u badan inay ka reebto tartanka Australian Open ee January.
